rapport_notes: Patient and collaborative problem-solving on the elevator/projector-screen worry, warm tone throughout.

evidence_quotes.agenda: Quick question for you. As you aside from the price and the quote in general, do you have any specific concerns or important questions you had answers during this call today?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised the projector-screen/elevator worry; rep asked what the item was, asked what floor she was on, then proposed using the stairs — customer said 'I didn't even think about the stairs... perfect.'

top_strength: Dug into the projector-screen/elevator concern with real follow-up (item, floor, stairs solution) instead of a token acknowledgment — customer explicitly said the answer resolved her worry.
coaching_note: Never got to a full estimate/anchor number before the call ended (customer was still comparing other movers) — worth trying to lock in a ballpark range earlier so the caller has something concrete to compare against other quotes.
